verdict.rationale: Column is a developer banking API. A platform like this could plausibly offer automation or rules features, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no versioning, review, or rollback of automations. Sandbox simulation, transfer holds, and idempotency keys are adjacent controls, not versioned automations with rollback, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
